To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a simple and efficient classification scheme based on hippocampal features that achieves high classification accuracies for the diagnosis of subjects with AD versus NC and AD versus MCI.
the proposed approach can be used as a complementary tool for AD classification and can be easily extended to other neurodegenerative diseases.
(1) hippocampal visual descriptors can be used for AD diagnosis; (2) late fusion of hippocampal visual and volumetric features increases the classification performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the automatic classification of AD from structural MRI, based on a visual approach.
the automatic classification of AD from MRI based on a late fusion of visual features from hippocampal area.
the development and evaluation of a novel AD recognition framework using visual features extracted from hippocampal area.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our approach is a very promising tool for the early AD diagnosis.
the proposed framework provides the best classification results for AD and MCI diagnosis compared to other methods in the literature.
the proposed approach has the ability to classify AD patients and NC subjects in a very accurate manner.   1
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed approach can be used to support clinical decision making in the context of AD.
visual information from the hippocampus is sufficient to classify AD and that the fusion of visual and volumetric information improves the classification results.
the hippocampal visual information is a good source of knowledge for AD diagnosis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
visual features can be used to classify AD subjects and that they can be extracted automatically from MRI.
the proposed visual features from the hippocampus area are able to discriminate AD from NC and MCI patients and that they can be used for a simple and efficient classification framework for AD.
visual features can be successfully applied for AD classification and can provide a complementary tool to existing volumetric approaches.
